rules.pattern: do not bump the version number; the owner releases by hand
rules.proposal: Add a rule that sessions never bump the version number. The owner releases by hand, and corrected this in three sessions across two repos on two days.
rules.patch:
--- a/CLAUDE.md
+++ b/CLAUDE.md
@@ -3,2 +3,5 @@
 ## Dates
 Write dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
+
+## Versions
+Never bump the version number. The owner releases by hand.
rules.why_not_covered: Checked ~/.agents/CLAUDE.md: its only rule is about dates. No skill or AGENTS.md rule mentions version numbers.

rules.covered_by: ~/.agents/CLAUDE.md, section Dates: Write dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
